mechanism_narrative: A positive 3-month change in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an ongoing tightening cycle that is already priced in, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS has a positive 3-month change, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 255.5 signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in further rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 255.5, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) has a positive 3-month change and CPIAUCSL exceeds 255, the market is pricing in a sustained tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS has positive 3mo change and CPIAUCSL > 255, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 3.5% and employment (PAYEMS) has a positive 3-month change, the labor market is tight, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS has positive 3-month change, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive 3-month change in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where INDPRO has positive 3-month change, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST value below 1200 signals weak housing market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) have a positive 3-month change and retail sales (RSAFS) have a positive 3-month change, the demand for goods is strong, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST positive 3mo change AND RSAFS positive 3mo change
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both have positive 3-month changes, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 255.5 signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in further rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 255.5, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
